title: Reproducibility package for Exact Erasure Thresholds and Sharp Stability Profiles for Structured Walsh--Block-Hadamard Frames
description: Code, machine-readable numerical results, verification reports, and reproducibility figures supporting the article 'Exact Erasure Thresholds and Sharp Stability Profiles for Structured Walsh--Block-Hadamard Frames'. The archive verifies implementation-level consequences of exact analytical results for a structured redundancy-two Walsh--block-Hadamard Parseval frame family, including erasure thresholds, sharp worst-case stability profiles in the proved range, critical-pattern counts, decoder checks, weighted-branch stability, and fixed-seed random-erasure experiments. The unpublished manuscript source and manuscript PDF are intentionally not included in this software release.
notes: Numerical computations in this archive verify and illustrate analytically proved results; they are not substitutes for proof.
